account_id_note: Local Mandri profile identifier. This is not an access key.
sources_note: API equivalent for the selected period and scope: gateway calls and native Codex, Claude and Antigravity usage through their accounts and subscriptions. Amounts are API-rate estimates, excluding subscription fees. An asterisk indicates a known subtotal.
cost_info: Estimated at standard text API rates, excluding subscriptions. Usage without a known price is excluded from this amount.
quality_note: Totals may be incomplete. Excluded events are daemon-wide and are not counted.
subtitle: Measured traffic, API equivalents and account allowances.
cost_short_note: API equivalent · not your subscription bill
discarded_note: Excluded history events on this daemon: {{count}}. These events are absent from the totals; zero unclassified retained observations does not mean complete history.
discard_reasons_title: Excluded history events on this daemon
unclassified_note: {{count}} observations have no identified model. Their token usage is retained, but their dollar value is unavailable.

unpriced_reasons.tariff_or_context_unavailable: Matching price or pricing context unavailable

no_groups: No measured usage to break down.
chart_note: Daily observations · {{timezone}} · gaps are not zero
chart_inspect: Select a day to inspect its measured usage.
breakdown_note: Observed traffic for the selected scope and period.
collection_gaps: Collection gaps on this daemon: {{count}}. Ambiguous or invalid observations are excluded from totals; known subtotals may be incomplete.
title: Usage
no_evidence_time: Last observation time unavailable; snapshot time is not collection freshness.
erase_note: This permanently erases this session’s numerical usage and prevents automatic history reimport. It does not delete the conversation or restore account allowance. Stop a running session first. If parent totals include this usage, the daemon may reject erasure rather than silently erase a broader scope.
erase_confirm: I understand and want to permanently erase this session’s metrics.
erased: Session metrics erased. Other retained history and account snapshots are unchanged.
name: Name / date
coverage_detail: {{facts}} retained observations · {{incomplete}} incomplete · {{unpriced}} not valued · {{unclassified}} unclassified
invoice_note: Hypothetical standard TEXT API token tariff equivalent: standard/global pricing, 5-minute cache writes and implicit cache reads where applicable. Explicit user price overrides may vary. Not an invoice, subscription charge or exact modality fee. Exact model/context matches only; unknown pricing stays unavailable, never zero.
requests_note: Known measured requests; native totals may not expose request counts.
empty: No observed usage in this scope and period. This does not establish zero consumption.
missing_note: — means unavailable, not zero. Known subtotals may exclude missing data. Coverage describes observed traffic only.
time_gaps_note: These records are not assigned to chart dates. Undated or overlapping usage is shown separately from the selected period subtotal; do not add overlapping totals.
truncated: Showing {{shown}} of {{total}} groups. Narrow the scope to inspect more.
collection_note: The daemon collects usage independently. Closing this page or hiding the app does not stop collection.
offline: Daemon disconnected. Any displayed snapshot is stale; reconnecting will reload it.
error: Could not read usage. Any displayed snapshot is stale.
descendants_note: Session total includes attributed descendants. Child rows are detail, not extra consumption to add to the parent.
direct_note: Direct session usage only. Parent-inclusive native totals may not support a separate direct allocation.
account_scope: Account-wide allowances include activity outside Mandri. Independent windows are not added together and are not attributed to this session or project.
no_accounts: No account snapshots available. This does not mean zero remaining allowance.
retention_note: Numerical usage metrics are retained, including when the native conversation is purged. Erasing metrics is a separate operation.
